name: Gurenka
source:
"A Supernatural Pure Love story Woven by Youkai and Humans"

Ryouji lives in the secluded mountain town of Sakai-chou. One day, he received a message on his answering machine not to let anyone into the house no matter who it was. In addition, there was something about the letter on the table, but he couldn’t understand all of it due to the static. He opened the letter anyway and inside was a old sepia-coloured letter, with a strange mark that he recalled seeing at the local abandoned shrine. There was a large stone in the middle and when he approached it, he heard a female voice and he felt a pain in his chest. Returning later due to curiosity, he noticed that the emblem on the stone was glowing. All of a sudden, he was dragged into a dark world and a naked girl Kuon was standing in front of him. She was a spirit that was sealed within the stone hundreds of years ago and she decided to thank him by tearing him to pieces and eating him. Just as suddenly, they were back in the real world and all his injuries were healed. It appeared that he had gained her powers which were within the keystone and so he was thrust into battle to retrieve all the broken shards. What is the other world and the village legend which has been passed down? He set out with Kuon and three other girls to seek the truth.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/06/06/june-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
「由你與妖怪共同編織的超自然純愛故事。」

涼士居住在偏僻的堺町山鎮。某天，他從答錄機裡聽到留言：無論來者是誰，都不準讓任何人進屋。此外，桌上還有一封信，但由於靜電干擾，他無法完全聽清留言的內容。他還是拆開了信封，裡面是一封泛黃的舊信，上面有一個奇怪的印記；他記得自己曾在當地的廢棄神社見過這個印記。神社中央有一塊巨石，當他靠近時，聽見了女性的聲音，胸口也隨之傳來一陣劇痛。後來，他因為好奇再次返回，發現石頭上的徽記正發著光。突然間，他被拖進了黑暗世界，一個裸體少女久遠站在他面前。她是數百年前被封印在石頭裡的靈體，決定把他撕成碎片吃掉，以此向他道謝。可就在下一瞬間，他們又回到了現實世界，而他的傷勢也全部痊癒。看來，他獲得了封印在基石中的力量，於是被捲入尋找所有碎片的戰鬥。另一個世界究竟是什麼？流傳於村中的傳說又隱藏著什麼？他與久遠及另外三名女孩一起出發，尋找真相。
